speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: なあ 貫ってくれないかなあせっかく精霊の森まで行って手に入れたんだからさ
original_en:
I need you to take something off my hands.
I went to the Forest of Spirits to get it!

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: 永遠の命を持つと言われるエルフの目を盗んで持ってきた宝なのに… <PART> …何だか 〓くなってきたな体じゃなく心が…さ…
original_en:
I brought this treasure I stole from
one of those supposedly immortal elves. <PART>
---
But for some reason I feel really cold...
It's not my body, it's...my soul.

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: 今は話しかけないでくれ…〓心中なんだ…
original_en:
Please don't talk to me.
I've fallen on hard times.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: あ あの…そういうの ちょっと困ります
original_en:
Well, umm...
That's kind of a problem, you see...

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: そろそろ出発しなきゃなまた魔物と闘うのはうんざりだが… <PART> 俺はまだ出会った事が無いんだけど普通の武器では〓つけられない魔物がいるそうだ <PART> そういう時はどうするかって？まぁ 手っ取り早いのは魔法だろうなぁ
original_en:
Well, I should be going soon.
I dread having to fight monsters again. <PART>
---
Although I've never met any, I hear that
some monsters are immune to normal weapons. <PART>
---
And what would one do then?
I suppose magic is the easiest way.

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: 普通の武器で〓つけられない魔物には魔法だな魔法の代わりになる道〓もあるぞ
original_en:
If weapons can't hurt a monster, use magic.
Some items can be used in place of magic.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 外が騒がしいけれど…何かあったのかしら…あ 失礼しました
original_en:
What's goin' on out there? Somethin' happen <PART> ---- <PART>
Oh, I mean, how may I be of service, ma'am?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: お〓様がいらっしゃる限り私はソルデで宿屋を続けます
original_en:
As long as customers need a place to stay,
the Solde Inn will remain open.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 初めてご利用されるお〓様ですね？ようこそ 港町ソルデへ <PART> 宿に〓まれば 戦いで疲れた体もあっという間に〓されますよ <PART> それこそ 〓死〓前の状〓だって〓日には元気いっぱい間違い無しです
original_en:
This is your first time staying with us?
Welcome to the seaport of Solde! <PART>
---
A quick rest at our inn will heal
even the most worn-down body! <PART>
---
Even if you're on the brink of death,
you'll wake up feeling good as new!

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: なあ 貫ってくれないかなあ今度こそ気に入ると思うんだけどさ
original_en:
I need you to take something off my hands.
This time, I think you'll really like it.

speaker: Adventurer
original_jp: 大陸の〓〓まで行って精霊の森に再挑戦してまで取ってきたのに… <PART> …何だか〓くなってきたな心にブリザードが吹き荒れてるぜ…
original_en:
I went down to the southeast to get this one,
back into the Forest of Spirits. <PART>
---
It makes it feel really cold,
like a blizzard whirling in my soul.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 〓まりかしら？〓めのいい部屋が空いてますよ
original_en:
Will you be staying?
We have a room with a view available.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: いらっしゃいませ お〓りですか？
original_en: Welcome. Would you like a room?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: おっと 〓まりのお〓かな？
original_en: Oh my, guests looking for a room?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 旅人さんだね 〓まっていくかい？
original_en: Yer travelers, right? Ya gonna stay?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: いらっしゃーいええと 〓まり…よね？
original_en:
Greetings and Salutations. You look like
you're looking for a room. Am I right?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ようこそお出で下さいましたお〓りでしょうか？
original_en:
It is an honor to receive your visit.
Shall I book your room?

speaker: Owner
original_jp: そうですか…またの機会をお待ちしてますね
original_en:
That's a shame.
Come back if you change your mind.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 機会がありましたら〓非当〓をご利用下さい
original_en:
Please visit us again,
when you have the chance.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: なんじゃ 久しぶりの〓かと思ったのにのう…
original_en: It figures. And I got all worked up.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: おや 〓やかしは御免だよ
original_en: Be on yer way then, no loiterin'.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 何だ 残念～ウチはサービスいいのに
original_en:
Well, it's your loss.
You're missing out on great service.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ご縁がありましたらまたいらして下さいね
original_en:
If ever the opportunity should arise,
please pay us your custom again.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 波の〓は〓りを誘う子守〓ごゆっくりお〓み下さい
original_en:
Let the lullaby of the waves
be your invitation to slumber.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: それでは どうぞごゆっくりとお〓み下さい
original_en: Please enjoy your stay.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: おお そうか〓まるかゆっくり〓んどくれよ
original_en:
So you're really staying?
Take a load off!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: シーツは洗い立てだからね気持ちよく〓れるよ！
original_en:
I just cleaned the sheets.
Yer gonna sleep like a baby!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ご〓大〓りサービスするわねごゆっくり～
original_en:
Balanced breakfast on the house!
Sleep tight.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: お疲れでしょう？ゆっくりしていって下さいね
original_en:
You must be exhausted.
Please make yourself comfortable.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: いってらっしゃいませ海の女神の加護があらんことを
original_en:
Visit again soon!
May the blessings of the sea be with you.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ご利用ありがとうございましたお気をつけて
original_en:
Thank you for your patronage.
Please take care.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 近くに来たら また〓っておくれよ
original_en: Come by any time you're in the area.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ぐっすり〓れたろ？気をつけていっておいで！
original_en:
Ya got a good night's rest, didn't ya?
Watch yer back out there!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: ふふ ゆっくり出来た？ また来てね～
original_en: Hehe, did you sleep okay? Come again soon!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 疲れは取れましたか？お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ
original_en:
I trust you rested well.
We look forward to serving you again soon.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: あら 宿〓〓がちょっと足りないみたい…
original_en: Uh-oh, you don't have enough money.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: 宿〓〓をお支払いになれませんとお〓めする事が難しいのですが…
original_en:
I'm afraid it would be impossible to allow
you to stay without paying the proper fee.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: なんじゃ 金が無きゃ〓められんぞ
original_en: Oh, this won't do. You can't afford it.

speaker: Owner
original_jp: お金貫わなきゃ〓められないよウチも〓売だからね
original_en:
This ain't enough! Whaddaya tryna pull?
This is a business, ya know!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: う～ん…ちょっとお金足りないわね…〓いだらまた来てね～
original_en:
Hmm... Looks like you're a little short.
Come back when you have the money!

speaker: Owner
original_jp: お〓様 代金が若干足りないようですので今回はちょっと…
original_en:
I'm afraid we require full payment
in advance in order to allocate rooms.
